resources.string: Only ordinary browsing history is saved on this device; private tabs are not recorded. The limit is the most recent %1$d addresses. Records at least %2$d days old are cleaned up when the app uses history. Opening an entry visits the page. Removing or clearing history does not affect bookmarks, cookies, or saved media.
Reading or saving history is not confirmed. Check available storage, then read again. You can also explicitly clear the history store.
No browsing history. Completed page visits in ordinary tabs appear here.
History storage is responding slowly. Waiting for this operation to finish.
History has changed. Review the current list before trying again.
This deletes all ordinary browsing history from this device, including entries that could not be read. Bookmarks, cookies, and saved media are unchanged. This cannot be undone.
Only this ordinary browsing history entry will be deleted. Bookmarks, cookies, and saved media are unchanged. This cannot be undone.
